title: Budget a network on paper
brief: Count the parameters, flops, and stored activations of a network from its layer shapes, and see why the sawtooth is cheap in depth.
hints: Each layer holds W with shape (out, in) and b with shape (out,). Their sizes are out * in and out.
Per layer, flops are 2 * in * out for the product, out for the bias, and out times the bend cost: relu 1, gelu 9, identity 0.
For stored activations, count the input once, then add the number of outputs of every layer, which is W.shape[0].
